entities.name: Werner Ostendorff
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Werner Ostendorff was a German SS-general during World War II who served as chief of staff of the II SS Panzer Corps and divisional commander of the SS Division Das Reich. He died of wounds in May 1945.
